name: @repo/ai-conversation
description: Thread scroll container that follows the bottom only while the reader is already there, offering a jump-to-latest pill when it stops.

useCases: Scroll container for a chat thread
Streaming transcript that must not fight the reader
Agent log that grows while being read
compositionHints: Pass contentKey so it knows when content grew
Scrolling up during a stream is respected — it stops following
Give it a bounded height; it manages its own overflow
